title: Fresh-context security review, the project's review skill, plugin pins
summary: A security-reviewer agent (Opus, read-only, enforced) that reads a diff it did not write, a project skill holding the invariants and the scanner routing, and a check that Claude Code plugins stay at the commit that was reviewed.
postInstall: Fill .claude/skills/project-security-review/SKILL.md: the trigger list (same as CLAUDE.md § Before pushing) and one bullet per invariant of your architecture.
Record in scripts/reviewed-plugins.json every Claude Code plugin the project relies on, at the commit you read (docs/conventions/security-review.md § Plugins).
Restart open Claude Code sessions so the new agent and skill are picked up.
